_: For each scenario of the edge campaign: what was fixed in the hardening round of 21 November 2026 because of it, and what is left. `edge-campaign-evidence.py --markdown --notes` adds both to the summary table. A key that ends with * matches every scenario that begins with it.
baseline: Contributor ingest ring; playlists from stamps
reader-delay-*: Reader asks ahead, and no more than 2 s ahead
reader-delay-300ms: Reader asks ahead; stays on a live cache
A far viewer needs a lower rendition to start on: use a ladder
reader-reorder-duplicate: 4K over one TCP connection under heavy reordering needs a lower rendition: see ladder-hlsjs-reorder
reader-rate-cap: The reader model does not choose a rendition: see ladder-hlsjs-rate-cap
reader-asymmetric: One request for each 5 ms part costs about 220 kbit/s of uplink: grouped parts (gap 9)
reader-partition-heals: Reader follows the playlist past lost parts
mesh-loss-*: A copy that warms on a lossy link can list a playlist that ends seconds behind live
mesh-burst-loss: 2 to 3% of the 4K parts are not delivered when bursts lose 70% of the packets
mesh-delay-jitter: A late source symbol is not a lost one; fragment disorder limit off
mesh-reorder-duplicate: A late source symbol is not a lost one; fragment disorder limit off
mesh-partition-edge-heals: An edge that has lost its parents answers 503 at once
mesh-flap-edge: An edge that has lost its parents answers 503 at once
A 4K reader can stall once for 0.6 to 2.1 s: the next edge holds its request
mesh-rate-cap-edge: An edge whose private link is narrower than its playlists is not taken out of assignment
wan-*: Wide-area protection is sized for a configured loss; lost parts are not signalled (gap 8)
wan-partition-region-heals: Reader stays on a live cache whose stream has stopped
The region has no media for the length of the cut
contributor-uplink-loss: Wide-area protection is sized for a configured loss; lost parts are not signalled (gap 8)
edge-kill: Standby copy; alternates in standby order
edge-freeze-resume: Alternates in standby order; reader ignores a reload to a cache that it has left
edge-rolling-restart: A 4K reader that is drained to an edge that has just started can stall for under half a second
distributors-both-*: Lost-parents answer; pathway in the neighbouring region
Readers lose the seconds until they play from the neighbouring region
relay-*: Reader follows the playlist past lost parts
The parts in flight are lost and not signalled (gap 8)
contributor-freeze: Reader stays on a live cache whose stream has stopped; larger publication queue
The contributor wakes with a backlog and needs about 4 s to be live again
contributor-kill-restart: Segment numbers continue above the earlier ones
One contributor is one point of failure; no EXT-X-DISCONTINUITY (gap 11)
edge-cpu-starved: A starved edge is not taken out of assignment until it falls behind
edge-out-of-memory: On an instance with swap the squeezed edge slows instead of dying
capacity-edge-*: 5 ms parts cost one request each: about 60 audio readers for each vCPU (gap 9)
capacity-edge-4k: The instance's network, about 1 Gbit/s, is the limit, not the CPU
capacity-entry-joins: Entry point remembers the init scan
Ceiling not reached: the load tool falls behind first
flash-crowd: HTTP on its own runtime; pending assignments; init scan
An edge is sent more readers than it admits through the alternates of full edges. On Linode the load host could not drive the admitted readers
long-tail-one-stream-too-many: A full node refuses a new stream by name; an edge with no free slot sends the reader to another edge
capacity-seventeen-streams: The contributor is the limit: one vCPU does not carry sixteen audio streams of 5 ms parts beside 4K (gap 9)
spec-playlists: Stamps; reload rules; segment complete at its short last part; hint after the last listed part
No delta updates, no gap signalling
player-hlsjs-4k: A viewer far from the region needs a lower rendition
player-hlsjs-cache-kill: From an ocean away the move to a new connection at 16.5 Mbit/s stalls for 4 s: a ladder is the remedy
player-ffmpeg-4k: Stamps; cold copy held until playable
ladder-playlists: Ladder; rendition reports; renditions numbered from one instant; one date in every rendition
ladder-hlsjs-*: Ladder of four renditions; one date in every rendition
hls.js at one-second latency stalls on a shaped link with little room above the rendition (gap 3)
clock-skew-edge: Age of an advertisement by receipt
clock-skew-distributor: Age of an advertisement by receipt: readers are assigned and served
Audio readers of the region miss a quarter of their 5 ms parts
endurance-churn: Allocator settings; target duration follows a duration that recurs
Measured for 30 minutes after the fixes, not for hours
ladder-hlsjs-browser-cap: Ladder of four renditions; one date in every rendition
From an ocean away, on the commit before the date fix, it stalled 5.6 s
ladder-hlsjs-browser-steps: Ladder of four renditions; one date in every rendition
Local: no stall, 2160p again after 28 s where the criterion is 25 s
mesh-loss-2pct: Linode: one incident on one edge in each of two runs; local clean
mesh-loss-0.5pct: Loss-adaptive protection; one parent fills a hole
